models.collectorNote: Chevrolet running gear keeps them usable; the Bertone body's rust traps are the cost centre. Isetta-era Rivolta paperwork occasionally surfaces with cars.

generations.name: Rivolta IR 300 / IR 340
generations.note: The numbers are in the names: 300 hp standard, 340 for the IR 340. Four-speed manual or automatic.

models.intro: Renzo Rivolta's move from Isetta bubble cars to a Corvette-engined GT: Bertone styling (by the young Giugiaro), a pressed-steel monocoque, De Dion rear suspension and Chevrolet's 327. The IR 340 raised the tune; about 800 Rivoltas were built.
models.name: Rivolta IR 300

models.collectorNote: Bizzarrini's departure makes early A3/L documentation prized; big-block cars trade in a different league from small-blocks.

generations.name: Grifo Series I (A3/L)
generations.note: Small-block cars began at 300 hp; the 7 Litri's 427 was quoted at 400. Bizzarrini's competition A3/C was the same car in racing dress.

generations.name: Grifo Series II
generations.note: The Series II hid its headlamps and mostly took Ford's 351 Cleveland after Chevrolet supply tightened; the last cars are the rarest.

models.intro: The Rivolta formula turned up to supercar: Giotto Bizzarrini's chassis engineering, Bertone's most muscular coupé shape, and a ladder of Chevrolet and Ford V8s ending in the 7-litre big-block cars. The Grifo 7 Litri is Italy's answer to the Cobra question.
models.name: Grifo

models.collectorNote: Rarity is extreme and saloon values lag the coupés, the connoisseur's Iso, bought on body condition above all.

generations.name: Fidia (S4)
generations.note: Engines followed Iso's supply lines from Chevrolet to Ford; most cars were automatic.

models.intro: The four-door Iso, 'the fastest four seats in the world' in the advertising, and with a Corvette V8 up front the claim had substance. Ghia built the bodies; John Lennon bought one of the first. Fewer than 200 were made, first as the S4, then simply Fidia.
models.name: Fidia

models.collectorNote: The Gandini lines have aged into fashion; check the Ford-era cars for their (better) parts support through the Mustang world.

generations.name: Lele / Lele Sport
generations.note: The Sport of 1973 was a lightened, uprated special; standard cars favoured the automatic gearbox.

models.intro: Iso's seventies GT, named for Renzo Rivolta's wife: a Marcello Gandini-penned 2+2 that began with Chevrolet power, moved to Ford's Cleveland, and carried the marque through its final decade. About 285 were built, including the Marlboro-sponsored Lele Sport specials.
models.name: Lele
